prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1299; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on a street in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were driving and what the weather and road conditions were like?

A: I was driving down the main road heading toward the shopping center. It was a clear afternoon, the pavement was dry, and traffic was moderate.

Q: Tell me what happened right before the impact.

A: A car came over into my lane. I think it was crossing the center line to pass a slow truck. I hit my brakes and steered to the right, but the other vehicle still hit me nearly head-on.

Q: What was your approximate speed at the time?

A: I'd say around thirty miles an hour, maybe a little less because traffic was slowing down.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did your airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not deploy. The impact was not very hard.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene, or did you stay inside?

A: I got out and walked around for a minute. My neck felt stiff, but I didn't think much of it at first.

Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness in your neck?

A: The next morning it was pretty sore. By that evening I had trouble turning my head to the left, and I started taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider for this?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic and they diagnosed me with a neck strain. They gave me a muscle relaxer and told me to do some stretches.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the collision?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and the other driver was clearly at fault for crossing into my lane.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
